name: SwitchBot K10+ Pro (EU)

radios.note: Wi-Fi is 2.4 GHz and Bluetooth 5.0 per search snippets of SwitchBot's page; not re-opened.

matter.note: SwitchBot's support article on direct Matter covers the K10+ Pro Combo, and the product page says Matter needs a Hub 2. No CSA listing seen; certification of the plain K10+ Pro is unconfirmed.

apple_home.note: EU page lists Siri and says Matter needs the SwitchBot Hub 2. The direct, hub-free Matter route (iOS 18.4.1) is documented for the Combo only.

google_home.note: Listed as working with Google Home; Matter also possible with a SwitchBot Hub.

alexa.note: Listed as working with Alexa on SwitchBot's EU page.

home_assistant.note: No official Home Assistant page for this model found.

hubRequired.note: Hub 2 is only needed for Matter, per the product page.

localControl.note: Not stated by SwitchBot in pages found.

cleaning.note: Reviews say it mops, but no SwitchBot page seen confirms it.

navigation.note: Search snippets also mention a PSD distance sensor.

suctionPa.note: From search snippets of the product page; verify.

selfEmptying.note: The page describes a 4 L dust collection base; not confirmed to be in the plain K10+ Pro box.

summary: The SwitchBot K10+ Pro is a compact robot vacuum with LiDAR, 3,000 Pa suction and a dust-collection base. SwitchBot's EU page lists Alexa, Google Home and Siri, with Matter available through a SwitchBot Hub 2.
caveats: Matter needs a SwitchBot Hub 2 on the plain K10+ Pro; the direct route is documented for the Combo.
Mopping is not confirmed by SwitchBot pages seen.
